scope.limitation: AST inventory followed by manual call-chain tracing for the 15 reported findings, not line-by-line manual review of every source file

structuralScan.limitation: Factories and React components include nested declarations; length does not itself establish a runtime performance defect

probeRuns.name: core-rules-web
probeRuns.limitation: finite probe, no explicit parent deadline; completed normally and released all databases

probeRuns.name: renderer-initial
probeRuns.reason: Fixture used opacity 12..60 outside canonical 0..1 range, producing no changes; all other probes passed

probeRuns.name: renderer-settings-corrected
probeRuns.correction: Only opacity fixture changed to 0.12..0.60; only affected settings check rerun

reproduction.coreAndSkill: From apps/desktop: pnpm exec node --import tsx <probe.mts or skill-probe.mts>
reproduction.renderer: From apps/desktop: pnpm exec vitest run --config <vitest.config.mts> --workspace <vitest.workspace.mts>; affected-only retry uses -t "records settings"
reproduction.note: Restore archived probe sources into a newly owned temporary root and replace the root paths. Reuse existing workspace dependencies; no real profile/network/GUI should be connected.

evidenceLimits: Single samples are not p95 or GUI responsiveness measurements
Intercepted fs method calls and SQL prepare counts are not full OS I/O or affected row statistics
Renderer probes replace IPC and remote responses and only prove local collaboration and algorithm behavior
Core Rules numbers are not Desktop wrapper latency
Web measured the real projection helper, not HTTP end-to-end
Worker D1, native Mobile, installer and real marketplace network not exercised

retainedExistingDevelopmentInstance.purpose: Previously retained for user trial; no new instance created by the audit
